newsitem.title: FRANCE: High-life French tax collector jailed for 15 years.
newsitem.headline: High-life French tax collector jailed for 15 years.

text.p: A French court has jailed for 15 years a tax collector who embezzled 55 million francs ($9.5 million) to lead the high life and rain sumptuous gifts on his friends and mistresses.
The court in the Alpine lakeside town of Annecy gave 54-year-old Gerard Schouller the maximum sentence on Wednesday night on charges of embezzling public funds and falsifying accounts over a decade.

During the trial, the court was told Schouller's generosity earned him the nickname of "lord of the lake". He bought his mistresses trips around the world, sports cars and jewels from top Parisian jewellers and hired helicopters to fly to restaurants.
Schouller, who told the court he once dreamt of becoming a professional goalkeeper, also propped up the ailing local soccer club which went bankrupt within months of his arrest in 1993.
The state prosecutor told the court Schouller's performance was worthy of the Guinness Book of Records.
